baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated dhanub is an allotted share; mithl calibrates parity, ashabihim supplies the associated cohort, and the closing prohibition blocks pulling that allocation ahead of its time.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper place supplies the culpable displacement that makes the allocation consequential.
The share or lot image makes both repeated nouns a matched allocation rather than an unspecified consequence.
Similarity and equalization calibrate one share against the other.
Adherence and companionship define the cohort to which the wrongdoers' allotment corresponds.
Seeking a thing before its time makes the final clause a ban on advancing the allotted consequence.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers face a consequence like that of their companions.
changed_reading.after: Wrongdoers already stand under a parity-calibrated allotment matching the cohort with whom their wrongdoing associates them, but its delivery is not theirs to advance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
baseline_models.mechanism: A full bucket, an irrigation or lifting apparatus, paired equality, and accompaniment converge on a measured draw taken by turns; haste becomes an attempt to pull one's assigned draw forward.

activation_trace.role: The full-bucket image materializes each repeated dhanub as a filled measure.
The irrigation and lifting apparatus supplies the mechanism by which a filled measure is drawn and moved.
Equal matching makes the two bucket-measures commensurate.
Making one thing accompany another supplies the paired allocation of measure to cohort.

changed_reading.before: Dhanub denotes an abstract penal share and the wrongdoers should not demand it early.
changed_reading.after: The clause also supports a material analogy of equal filled draws assigned to successive cohorts, with haste pictured as interfering with the order of drawing.

baseline_models.mechanism: The tail, ending, and follower branches of dhanb combine with companionship and equality: the wrongdoers can be read as trailing adherents whose comparable end follows the cohort they continue.

activation_trace.role: The tail and ending image turns the share into an end that comes behind what precedes it.
Followers attached to leaders supply a diachronic relation between current wrongdoers and a prior cohort.
Continuing adherence makes the companions a shared-pattern cohort, not necessarily only present associates.
Matching binds the followers' end to the end of those they trail.

changed_reading.before: Ashabihim names the wrongdoers' contemporaneous associates.
changed_reading.after: Ashabihim can name a transhistorical cohort they follow: adherence reproduces the pattern, and a matching end arrives at the tail of that succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier assigned time and respite, followed immediately after the focus by a promised day, turn the ban on haste into a fixed schedule for the matched allotment rather than an indefinite postponement.

activation_trace.role: The share image supplies the item whose delivery is temporally governed.
Seeking before the proper time is the temporal action revised by the context.
Assigning a known time supplies a bounded interval before consequence.
Waiting and granting respite make delay an active allowance rather than absence of outcome.
A defined duration gives the warning a temporal container.
A promise fixed to a time or place identifies the endpoint governing the preceding no-haste clause.

structural_cues: 51:44 places seizure after defiance and within a scene of watching.
51:60 immediately names the day they are promised.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assigned interval, respite, a bounded day, and a timed promise; I infer that these cues govern the focus prohibition and schedule its allotment. A live alternative is that each timing cue belongs only to its local episode and the focus uses delay rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: Do not hurry the punishment because it has merely been deferred.
changed_reading.after: Do not try to advance a matched share whose interval and promised endpoint are already fixed; respite is scheduled, not cancellation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Precedence, the same circulating accusation, and the image of one thing being linked or passed to another turn the focus companions into a diachronic cohort whose recurring response is followed by a recurring allotment.

activation_trace.role: Followers attached to preceding leaders make the present wrongdoers the trailing members of a repeated pattern.
Adherence defines companionship by participation in the same response across time.
Matching connects repeated conduct to a corresponding repeated share.
Precedence places the earlier peoples ahead of the focus wrongdoers in a temporal sequence.
A saying spread among people supplies the recurring verbal pattern shared by separated cohorts.
Linking one thing to another makes the rhetorical transmission question a mechanism of historical continuity.
Mutual passing of an injunction sharpens the image of cohorts handing on one response.

structural_cues: 51:38-46 presents successive peoples and successive consequences.
51:52 explicitly compares the present response with those before them.
51:53 asks whether the cohorts transmitted the response to one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior cohorts, the same saying, precedence, and a transmission link; I infer that ashabihim can span time and that matched conduct generates matched allotment. The live alternative is resemblance without transmission, with ashabihim restricted to contemporaries.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers receive what their immediate associates received.
changed_reading.after: The wrongdoers join a transmitted historical cohort: they trail the same response and therefore inherit a share matching earlier adherents.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, apportioned provision and sustenance establish a one-way distribution from the self-sufficient provider; the focus dhanub then reads as a dark counter-allotment, a measured share rather than something supplied to God.

activation_trace.role: The share or lot image lets dhanub enter the adjacent distributive frame.
The full measure supplies a material container for the counter-allotment without replacing the penal sense.
An apportioned gift establishes distribution while the verse denies that any such gift is demanded from them.
Sustenance and livelihood specify the provisioning domain that the focus reverses.
Repeated apportioned giving fixes the direction of distribution with God as giver immediately before the penal share.

structural_cues: 51:57 denies that God seeks provision or feeding from them.
51:59 immediately assigns the wrongdoers a dhanub.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent apportioned provision, sustenance, a giver-to-recipient direction, and focus branches for share and full measure; I infer a deliberate distributive reversal in which punishment is an anti-provision. The alternative is a simple contrast with no shared allocation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers possess an abstract portion of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their portion is framed as a measured counter-provision dispensed by the one who needs nothing from them: not sustenance they give, but an allocation they receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Proper pairing is followed by the prohibition against assigning another deity alongside God; the focus then reverses misplaced association by locating valid equality not at the divine level but between wrongdoers and the shares of their real cohorts.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in the wrong place supplies the error of assigning equivalence where it does not belong.
Equality returns as a correctly placed correspondence between penal shares.
Association identifies the actual peers among whom correspondence holds.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the section's legitimate pairing frame.
Assigning a thing a status supplies the act by which a false counterpart is positioned.
Worship and the worshipped object specify the relation in which the prohibited equivalence is made.
Otherness after a first marks the rival term placed alongside God.

structural_cues: 51:51 forbids making another deity with God.
51:59 uses equality and companionship only for matched penal shares.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proper counterparts, a prohibited assigned deity, focus misplacement, and focus equality; I infer a retributive reversal from false equivalence to correctly located equivalence. The alternative is that the pairing and deity prohibition do not govern mithl in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Mithl merely compares one punishment with another.
changed_reading.after: Mithl becomes an ironic correction: those who misplaced equivalence are assigned a true equivalence, a share matching the associates who are actually their peers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of prior outcomes is explicitly mobilized as warning and reminder; this activates the punishment and lesson branches of mithl so that each matched share also turns its recipient into the next cautionary instance.

activation_trace.role: The allotted share supplies the consequence that can become publicly exemplary.
Exemplary punishment turns matched consequence into deterrent display.
The lesson or sign image gives the matching relation a mnemonic function.
A reminder that causes recollection frames the surrounding correspondences as material for recognition.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the intended effect of the historical and future examples.
Repeated reminder makes the exemplary pattern an active interpretive function, not background history.
Benefit specifies the positive audience effect that the punitive example can produce.

structural_cues: 51:38-46 supplies a serial display of prior outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial outcomes, warning, reminder, and benefit; I infer that the focus matching share is designed to create another exemplary instance. The alternative is that mithl remains comparison only and the warning function belongs to the larger passage without entering the word.

changed_reading.before: The share matches an earlier punishment privately at the level of outcome.
changed_reading.after: The matched share also installs its recipient as the next warning-example, extending the passage's chain of remembered outcomes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links peripheral material branches for a full bucket, irrigation gear, apportioned provision, and bucket depletion across adjacent forms. It remains valid as a material analogy because both dhanub and yasta'jilun are focus anchors and the adjacent rizq and qwwa branches converge on measured distribution. Downstream prose should mark it as exploratory imagery, not a lexical replacement or a literal well scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

activation_trace.role: A full bucket supplies the filled unit assigned in the focus.
A share or lot converts the filled unit into an allotment.
Irrigation and lifting machinery supplies a concrete draw mechanism behind the no-haste command.
Apportioned giving supplies the distribution logic for successive filled measures.
The bucket whose water is drawn down gives an adjacent, branch-distant echo of the focus vessel image.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers receive a figurative share and are told not to hurry it.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory material overlay pictures a provider-controlled draw: a filled measure is allotted to each cohort, so demanding haste is demanding one's draw before its turn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates race and route branches from al-matin and yasta'jilun rather than their ordinary local senses. It stays anchored through the focus command against haste, the matching cohort, and the immediately preceding branch of race-respite. Render it only as a kinetic overlay in which delay paces a fixed outcome, not as a claim that the verse literally describes a race.

activation_trace.role: Tail and ending supply a finish toward which the paced succession moves.
Matching places the cohorts on comparable courses with corresponding outcomes.
Companionship supplies the peer group whose pacing is compared.
Rapid travel and a shortened route materialize the forbidden attempt to compress the course.
Prolonged matching or keeping pace supplies a contest whose duration can be extended.
Granting respite in a race turns immediate adjacency into a cue for paced delay without loss of endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The command simply denies a request for immediate punishment.
changed_reading.after: The cohorts can be pictured on a divinely paced course: respite lengthens the interval, while matched shares preserve the finish and no participant can shorten the route.

strongest_changes: The context turns no-haste from vague deferment into a fixed interval ending at a promised day.
The repeated historical response turns companions into a diachronic cohort whose followers inherit a matching share.
Adjacent provision language recasts dhanub as a measured counter-allotment from the self-sufficient provider.
The deity prohibition makes the focus equality an ironic correction of misplaced equivalence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus itself joins share, full-bucket, irrigation-apparatus, parity, and cohort branches; adjacent provision and strength branches intensify that unusual distributive image, while the passage's temporal and historical sequencing keeps it anchored as a scheduled consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The bucket and irrigation convergence may be intentional material activation or only a branch-level echo; it should not displace the penal-share reading.
Ashabihim may include both contemporaries and historical predecessors, and the context does not force only one scope.
The race-respite image from al-matin is branch-distant and should remain an exploratory pacing analogy.
The corrective-equivalence reversal is coherent but depends on reading the pairing and deity prohibition as governing the later mithl.
